lines.trans: Go stand in front of the shelf and block the camera.
Just pretend we are sorting something here.
Peter, I really don't feel like doing this in my first week.
Come on, just do it now!
I'm in my trial week! I don't feel like getting fired right now.
For the past two weeks there have been new cameras everywhere here.
Thorsten got fifteen thousand euros for that.
Since then I haven't been able to pocket anything here. Is it covered now?
Yes, now it is covered. Okay.
